catalysts.headline: FDA End-of-Phase 1 Type B meeting (in-person, FDA White Oak campus) for lead candidate NEO212 to discuss proposed patient population, trial design, endpoints, dose selection, and the evidence that could support a future marketing application
catalysts.impact: Company explicitly states the meeting's scheduling does not itself establish FDA agreement on trial design, an accelerated approval pathway, or eventual approval

catalysts.headline: Scheduled FDA End-of-Phase 1 Type B meeting for NEO212 (in-person, FDA White Oak campus) to discuss Phase 2 study design, proposed patient population, trial design/endpoints, dose selection, and potential for an accelerated-approval pathway. Still upcoming as of today (2026-11-11); no outcome reported yet.

FDA End-of-Phase 1 Type B meeting for NEO212 confirmed scheduled, in-person at the FDA's White Oak campus, to get feedback on patient population, trial design, endpoints, dose, and the accelerated-approval pathway
catalysts.note: No outcome yet (meeting is in the future as of this pass). An earlier End-of-Phase 1 meeting set for 2026-07-09 was canceled after FDA CMC feedback requiring an in vivo relative bioavailability study for the capsule-to-tablet transition. Company caveats: efficacy/safety not established, FDA feedback may differ from expectations, meeting could be rescheduled.

catalysts.headline: NeOnc Technologies scheduled to present two posters (NEO100 and NEO212 data) at the Society for Neuro-Oncology (SNO) annual meeting in Philadelphia, poster session 7:30-9:30pm.
catalysts.source: https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/NTHI/neonc-technologies-sno-annual-meeting-2026 ; https://finviz.com/news/399355/neoncs-fda-catalyst-run-could-give-nthi-a-serious-jolt (biopharmawatch discloses it is compensated by NTHI for coverage -- treat accordingly)

catalysts.headline: NeOnc reported Q3 2026 (quarter ended 2026-09-30) financial results: net loss narrowed to $4.4M from $8.6M in Q3 2025 (total opex $5.8M vs $6.9M); loss attributable to common stockholders $7.3M / $(0.28) per share vs $(0.45) a year earlier (includes $2.8M noncash deemed dividends from the Series A preferred redemption and a warrant down-round adjustment); cash $6,166,342 at 9/30/26 (up from $1.97M at 6/30/26 after the Sept 10 $15M registered direct offering closed); nine-month net loss $27,500,185; accumulated deficit $140,254,840; going-concern doubt continues. Release reiterated positive topline Phase 2a NEO100 data and the Nov 13 SNO poster presentations and highlighted the Abu Dhabi MOU.
Announced a memorandum of understanding with the Department of Health - Abu Dhabi for scientific exchange and clinical research collaboration.
catalysts.source: https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/NTHI/neonc-breaks-through-key-levels-brain-cancer-stock (biopharmawatch discloses it is compensated by NTHI for coverage; treat accordingly)

notes: Ticker NTHI corresponds to NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. (not 'Neuro-Hitech' or 'NeuroOne,' which do not trade under this ticker). Company selected a recommended Phase 2 dose of 610 mg for NEO212 following dose escalation to a protocol-defined maximum tolerated dose of 810 mg (exact date of this disclosure not confirmed). Fundamental figures vary enormously across aggregator sources — recommend verifying against NTHI's most recent 10-Q (apparently filed on/around 2026-08-10 for Q2 2026) on SEC EDGAR directly.
